name: rhythm90-play-builder
title: Play Builder
description: Turns a rough marketing idea into a sharp, testable Rhythm90 Play. Use when defining a play, experiment, quarterly bet, or hypothesis to put on the Quarter Board.

name: rhythm90-signal-lab
title: Signal Lab
description: Interprets messy observations into clear Rhythm90 Signals (summary, why it matters, next action, quarterly link). Use when decoding surprises, friction, performance shifts, or field feedback for the Signal Log.

name: rhythm90-ritual-guide
title: Ritual Guide
description: Designs Kickoff, Pulse Check, or Review & Renew agendas and facilitation prompts. Use when planning or facilitating a Rhythm90 team session.

name: rhythm90-media-mapper
title: Media Mapper
description: Builds a structured media strategy (reach, channel journey, flighting, sufficiency, test design, narrative) from audience, budget, goals, and evidence. Use when planning media mix, flighting, or media tests.

name: rhythm90-quarterly-planner
title: Quarterly Planner
description: Builds a quarterly Rhythm90 plan (objective, focus areas, plays, assumptions, signals, next steps) from business context and learning goals. Use when kicking off a quarter or resetting the Quarter Board.

name: rhythm90-plain-english-translator
title: Plain-English Translator
description: Rewrites marketing copy into clear human language with a side-by-side jargon table and glossary. Use when copy is corporate, vague, or jargon-heavy.

name: rhythm90-get-to-by
title: Get/To/By Generator
description: Crafts Get/To/By strategy statements from audience, insight, and brand role. Use when writing strategy statements or creative briefs.

name: rhythm90-creative-tension-finder
title: Creative-Tension Finder
description: Generates creative tensions from a problem/strategy summary with optional platform names. Use when ideating campaign territories.

name: rhythm90-persona-generator
title: Persona Generator + Ask Mode
description: Build an evidence-aware audience persona or a clearly labeled hypothetical persona for planning and research preparation.

name: rhythm90-journey-builder
title: Journey Builder
description: Maps a customer journey (stages, customer action, brand action, stuck stage) from product, objective, and optional barrier — same as Journey Builder. Use for journeys, funnels, or experience maps.

name: rhythm90-test-learn-scale
title: Test-Learn-Scale Roadmap
description: Designs an experimentation roadmap with hypotheses, test design table, learning application, and risk tips. Use for growth experiments and learning plans.

name: rhythm90-agile-sprint-planner
title: Agile Sprint / War-Room Planner
description: Outlines a marketing sprint/war-room plan (objective, roster, cadence, rituals, deliverables, DoD) from challenge, time horizon, and team roles.

name: rhythm90-connected-media-matrix
title: Connected-Media Moment Matrix
description: Creates a moment-based connected media matrix from audience snapshot, conversion action, and optional triggers.

name: rhythm90-synthetic-focus-group
title: Synthetic Focus Group
description: Explore hypothetical audience reactions to a concept and turn them into questions for real research. Use for ideation and interview preparation, never as customer validation.

name: rhythm90-five-cs
title: 5 C's Strategy Builder
description: Runs a 5 C's analysis (Company, Customer, Category, Culture, Competition) with strategic challenge and opportunity.

name: rhythm90-creative-platform-generator
title: Creative-Platform Generator
description: Generates 3–5 extensible creative platforms from audience, creative tension, and business objective.

name: rhythm90-hypothesis-builder
title: Hypothesis Builder
description: Crafts 1–3 sharp testable hypotheses from audience, problem, key signal, and desired outcome. Use before building a full Play.

name: rhythm90-operating-system
title: Operating System
description: Explains and applies the Rhythm90 quarterly OS (Plays, Signals, Rituals, Signal Log, Quarter Board, roles, cadence). Use when the user asks how Rhythm90 works or which skill/tool to use next.

name: rhythm90-study-coach
title: Study Coach
description: Help a reader understand and apply a Rhythm90 chapter using reflection, realistic scenarios, and feedback on their own work. Use for studying the book, not for running a team’s quarter.

name: rhythm90-review-renew
title: Review & Renew
description: Synthesize a quarter’s Plays and source evidence into a Review & Renew working document and next-cycle decisions. Use for end-of-cycle learning reviews, not a generic performance presentation.
